observation.happening: Meeting recording interface with microphone permission alert prominently displayed
observation.most_important: Microphone permission error blocking audio recording, with setup action available
observation.next_action: User should click '設定を開く' to grant microphone permission
anomalies: Main content area is predominantly empty - only alert and tabs visible
Large unused space below the alert message
Two-column left sidebar feels disconnected from alert flow

6D21.why: Functional alert system with clear messaging, but layout feels incomplete. Main content area is wastefully empty, and the permission dialog pattern is generic. State is clear but design lacks polish.

observation.happening: Home screen greeting with recording action prompt and empty state setup instructions
observation.most_important: Minimal interface inviting user to either start recording or set up Space
observation.next_action: User can click recording action or follow setup link
anomalies: Large white space indicating empty state
Instruction bullets placed after 'nothing yet' message suggests scaffold text

716C.why: Clean, calm execution with solid hierarchy and geometry. Sidebar and spacing are polished. However, the empty-state pattern and onboarding approach are conventional across modern productivity apps (Notion, Linear). Lacks distinctive voice.

observation.happening: Meeting detail view with structured notes (decisions/todos/notes) and timestamped dialogue transcript below
observation.most_important: Taxonomy of meeting outcomes (decisions, actions, notes) with full conversation timeline as reference
observation.next_action: User can review details, access transcript, related files, or sources

7923.why: Solid information architecture with clear taxonomy (決まったこと/やること/メモ) and transcript timeline. Hierarchy and state clarity are strong. However, the layout pattern (sections + tabs + transcript below) is conventional. Lacks visual personality or unexpected detail.

observation.happening: Home screen showing upcoming calendar events with recording badges and a follow-up task with progress tracking
observation.most_important: Clear visibility of scheduled meetings with recording option and pending action with progress counter
observation.next_action: User can record upcoming meetings or complete follow-up task
anomalies: Recording badge appears on both calendar events
Task progress shown as '1/2' suggesting two-part action

7A0A.why: Excellent state clarity - recording status, meeting times, and action progress are all immediately visible. Card layout for events is clean and aligned. However, this event-card-plus-action pattern is standard across calendar/productivity apps. Execution is polished but not surprising.

observation.most_important: Minimal interface with setup instructions to guide new user
observation.next_action: User follows onboarding or initiates recording
anomalies: Full-page instruction list is the default empty-state pattern
Instruction bullets repeat key features generically

7A9B.why: Calm, readable, and well-proportioned. Clear hierarchy and geometry. However, the empty-state pattern (full-page setup instructions + feature bullets) is the default across Notion, Linear, and modern productivity tools. Lacks distinctive approach or memorable moments.
